sentences.en: Most people think that gorillas are stupid. Is that true?
sentences.zh: 大多数人都认为大猩猩很愚蠢。真的吗？

sentences.en: Hundreds of people called or wrote to the Gorilla Foundation.
sentences.zh: 数百人给大猩猩基金会打电话或写信。

sentences.en: At that time I really understood that gorillas have feelings.
sentences.zh: 那时我真正理解到大猩猩也有感情。

phrases.zh: 大猩猩基金会：一个致力于保护和研究大猩猩的组织
